Chongqing重庆

A municipality the size of a country, with the industrial base to match.

Registered address
¥3k–10k / year
Typical setup
4–8 weeks
Region
Western China
Best suited to
Manufacturing, automotive, electronics, logistics along the Yangtze and consumer brands serving western China.

Chongqing is a province-sized municipality with a heavy industrial base: automobiles, electronics, motorcycles and the logistics corridor along the Yangtze. It is also one of China's fastest-growing consumer markets, with a population larger than most countries.

Foreign founders are fewer here, and the service ecosystem reflects it. Registration is possible, but the process is more locally negotiated and the quality of advice varies sharply by district. A local partner or a strong law firm is worth more here than in Shanghai.

What actually differs here?

Chongqing rewards local knowledge. If you do not have a trusted Chinese partner or adviser, budget for one before you sign anything.

Cheap space, cheap labour, generous industrial incentives; municipal processes are more fragmented than in coastal cities.

Before you commit to an address here

The figures on this page are ranges. District practice decides whether a specific address will register, bank and pass inspection — and it changes without much notice.

Take it to the counter: ask the district market regulator and the bank to confirm the address before you sign the lease, using the script in how to verify.

How to check it

Registration practice

How the paperwork actually goes in Chongqing

Registry speed, address rules and the district-level differences that decide whether a plan is realistic.

Registering

Registration is through the municipal portal with district review. Liangjiang New Area is the main industrial and foreign-investment zone; Jiangbei and Yubei are the commercial districts. The municipality's size means district-level practice can differ substantially.

Banking

Account opening is possible but slower, and branches may have less experience with foreign-owned companies. Prepare a complete document set and expect follow-up questions about the source of funds and the business model.

Work permits

Work permits are processed by the municipal science and technology bureau. The process is workable but slower for new companies, and the salary threshold is lower than in Beijing or Shanghai.

Address supply

¥3k–10k / year. Expect a lease, a property certificate and a utility bill in the company's name before a bank will look at the file.

Know before you commit

Three risks in this city

  • Assuming a municipal registration is uniform: district practice varies and inspections are local.
  • Signing an industrial lease without confirming power capacity and environmental zoning.
  • Relying on a translator for a contract whose Chinese text is the operative version.

Best suited to

Manufacturing, automotive, electronics, logistics along the Yangtze and consumer brands serving western China.
